summary: Bright Minds Biosciences Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K containing its unaudited condensed interim consolidated financial statements for the six months ended March 31, 2026. The filing is a routine periodic report under Rule 13a-16 or 15d-16, akin to a US quarterly report on Form 10-Q. It includes financial statements, MD&A, and CEO/CFO certifications. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or management change is disclosed. The report provides operational and financial updates without any transactional or strategic catalysts, making it a non-special-situation filing.
